scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Best Institution For Research In The Field Of Ageing
other_conditions: Institution must be a registered body
Minimum of five years experience in the field of ageing
Must have remarkable achievements in research or publication and knowledge dissemination
Must have outstanding achievements in education/training related to ageing or geriatric care
Must have contributed to policy and programme development for senior citizens at state or national level
Must disseminate knowledge and create awareness through conferences, seminars, workshops, etc.
Must demonstrate participatory leadership in community and civil society on ageing
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized person; self‑nominations are not accepted
benefits_summary: Award includes a citation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹5,00,000, together with travel, lodging and per‑diem expenses for the awardee and a companion.
